title: UserInvitation
description:
Model representing a user invitation.

This model contains the details of an invitation sent to a user, including the
invitation ID, who sent it, who it was sent to, and the roles that will be
assigned upon acceptance. The invitation URL is included for the user to accept
the invitation.

inviter.description: Details about the user who sent the invitation

invitee.description: Details about the user being invited

invitation_url.description: URL for the user to accept the invitation

created_at.description: Timestamp when the invitation was created

roles.description: List of roles that will be assigned upon acceptance
List of roles to assign to the invitee

Inviter.description:
Model representing the user who sent the invitation.

This model contains the details of the user who sent the invitation, including
their display name.
